items.title: How many strong cases get blocked by a slot cap?
items.description: L2 and L3 both warn that a case can clear the leveling rubric and still not result in a promotion, because some cycles cap how many promotions a level or org can approve. Set how many cases cleared the bar this cycle, then drag the available-slot cap to see how many of those genuinely strong cases still get blocked purely by the cap — nothing to do with the quality of their evidence.

params.name: casesClearingBar
params.label: Cases that cleared the rubric this cycle

items.compute: const blockedCases = Math.max(0, params.casesClearingBar - params.availableSlots); return { blockedCases };

outputs.label: Strong cases blocked by the cap
